content: Awař i dd-yusin zi SIDI ɣar Irmiya awarni řami t-i-dd-yiwi Nebuzaradan, řqebṭan n iɛessasen n arrimet, zi Rama. Umi t-i-dd-iwyen, ittwacarf netta s ssnaseř di řwesṭ n imenfiyyen zi Urcalim d Yahuda, inni ittwaneddhen d imenfiyyen ɣar Babil.
Řqebṭan n iɛessasen n arrimet i dd-yiwi Irmiya, inna as: “SIDI, AREBBI nnec, tuɣa ittbarreḥ s řɣar-a x wemcan-a
uca yarra i-t SIDI ad dd-yas uca Netta igga s min tuɣa inna, maɣar kenniw texḍam ak-d SIDI u war tesřim ca ɣar tmijja nnes. S uyenni kenniw iřqef man aya.

Řexxu maca, xzar, ad fesyeɣ ass-a ssnaseř nni x ifassen nnec. Mařa d lemliḥ di tiṭṭawin nnec ad kidi dd-tased ɣar Babil, xenni as-dd, u necc ad cek ksiɣ. Maca mařa d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin nnec maḥend ad kidi tuyured ɣar Babil, ejj i-t xenni. Xzar, marra tammurt zzatek. Cek tzemmared ad tuyured ɣar ijj n wemcan i d ac ittɣiř d mliḥ d nican di tiṭṭawin nnec!”

Umi tuɣa ɛad war dd-iɛqib, yarni inna: “Dweř-dd ɣar Jadalya, mmis n Axiqam, mmis n Cafan, wenni igga ujeǧid n Babil x tneddam n Yahuda uca qqim ɣares jar řgens, niɣ uyur mani tᵉttwarid mliḥ di tiṭṭawin nnec maḥend ad traḥed.” Xas uca iwca as řqebṭan n iɛessasen n arrimet řeɛweč i umuddu d ict n tarzeft uca ijja i-t ad yuyur.
Yuyur Irmiya ɣar Jadalya, mmis n Axiqam, ɣar Miṣfat. Iqqim ittnusa ɣares di řwesṭ n řgens nni tuɣa iqqimen ɛad di temmurt.

Řami marra ikumandaren n řɛeskarat nni iǧan deg iyyaren, nitni d iryazen nsen, sřin aqa ajeǧid n Babil igga Jadalya, mmis n Axiqam, x temmurt u igga i-t x yeryazen d temɣarin d iḥenjiren, x imezřaḍ qaɛ n temmurt u x marra inni tuɣa war ittwanedhen ɣar Babil,

usin-dd nitni ɣar Jadalya di Miṣfat: Ismaɛil, mmis n Natanya, Yuḥanan d Yunatan, iḥenjiren n Qariḥa, Saraya, mmis n Tanḥumat, arni xas iḥenjiren n Ɛifa, Anṭufati, d Yazanya, mmis n Umaɛki, marra nitni ak-d yeryazen nsen.
Jadalya, mmis n Axiqam, mmis n Cafan, ijjuǧ asen u i yeryazen nsen, inna: “War tteggʷdem maḥend ad tsexxarem i Ikaldaniyyen. Qqimem di temmurt uca sexxarem i ujeǧid n Babil, xenni ad tiřim mliḥ.

Uca necc, xzar, necc zeddɣeɣ di Miṣfat maḥend ad beddeɣ d amendub di ṭṭweɛ nwem zzat i wudem n Ikaldaniyyen nni ɣarneɣ i dd ɣa yasen. Ittxeṣṣa kenniw ad tessmunem binu d tini n unebdu d zzect, uca ggem aya deg iqdiḥen nwem uca zedɣem di tneddam nni tᵉṭṭfem.”

Uřa d marra Udayen nni iǧan di Mu’ab u jar ayt n Ɛammun u di Idum u di marra timmura inneɣni, sřin aqa ajeǧid n Babil ijja min iqqimen n imezdaɣ di Yahuda u igga xasen Jadalya, mmis n Axiqam, mmis n Cafan.
S uyenni dd-ɛeqben marra Wudayen zi marra imucan mani xasen uẓẓřen uca iwḍen ɣar temmurt n Yahuda ɣar Jadalya ɣar Miṣfat. Nitni ssmunen aṭṭas n binu d tini n unebdu.
Uřa d Yuḥanan, mmis n Qariḥa, d marra ikumandaren n řɛeskarat nni tuɣa deg iyyaren usin-dd ɣar Jadalya ɣar Miṣfat.
Nitni nnan as: “Ma tessned cek, aqa Baɛlis, ajeǧid n ayt n Ɛammun, issekk-dd Ismaɛil, mmis n Natanya, ḥima ad cek ineɣ?” Jadalya, mmis n Axiqam, maca war ten yumin.

Yuḥanan, mmis n Qariḥa, maca issiweř ak-d Jadalya s tnuffra di Miṣfat, inna: “Ejj ayi ad din řaḥeɣ u ad nɣeɣ Ismayil, mmis n Natanya. War t issin uřa d ijj. Mayemmi ɣa ineɣ ḥed u marra ayt n Yahuda i dd-xak imunen ad ttwasszuzzaren d min iqqimen zi Yahuda ad iweddar?”
Maca Jadalya, mmis n Axiqam, inna i Yuḥanan, mmis n Qariḥa: “War ttegg aya, maɣar min teqqared cek x Ismaɛil d ixarriqen waha.”
